derivations.notes: Materialization establishes current semantic-denominator authority; it does not author vectors, evaluate profiles, or provide empirical evidence.

derivations.notes: The audit proves accounting and derivation closure. It does not supply profile facts, author vectors, or certify conformance behavior.
